Kai: Summary of recurring issues: BGP flaps causing partial regional isolation, S3 lifecycle rules affecting incremental backups, and unclear Dedicated restore steps.

Action items:
- A1 (Marta): Update multi-region routing + health gating. Target failover <45s. Due 2026-04-10.
- A2 (Ash): BGP session monitoring + Slack alert + PagerDuty link. Due 2026-03-30.
- A3 (Ben): Nightly backup-restore smoke test in isolated VPC (cron 0 3 * * *). Smoke ~8m, full validate ~45m. Due 2026-03-28.
- A4 (Ben+Ash): Restore runbook: quick checklist (<=10 steps) + full playbook. Include expected RTOs. Due 2026-04-05.
- A5 (Priya): Add KMS decrypt preflight snippet and fallback contacts. Due 2026-03-25.
- A6 (Marta): Post-failover 5% traffic canary script (10m). Due 2026-04-12.
- A7 (Kai): Schedule quarterly DR game days; propose dates. Due 2026-03-22.

Marta: Draft routing policy snippet: set bgp local-preference 200 for primary region; health-check /healthz -> 3 consecutive 200s.

Ash: Will tie gating to both proxy and control-plane and set probe interval to 30s. Adding alerts + PD escalation.
